caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair, colored in various shades of green. The chair features a tall, slightly curved slatted back with three horizontal slats and a rounded top rail. The seat consists of parallel horizontal slats, matching the back in color. The armrests are wide and slightly curved, and each is supported by vertical posts at the front corners. The legs are straight and rectangular, all rendered in the same green color as the rest of the chair. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations. The drawing is centered on the page, showing the chair in a three-quarter view from the front left side.
title: Wooden Chair
